<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Add deepseek_v4_flash 1p1d accuracy case and register it to the nightly pipeline

## Modifications

1. Add accuracy test case test/registered/npu/accuracy/deepseek_v4_flash/test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_0731_w8a8_1p1d_16p_gpqa.py :

- Implement a multi-node PD-Sep accuracy test based on TestNpuAccuracyMultiNodePdSepTestCaseBase , reusing DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_0731_W8A8_MODEL_PATH from test_npu_performance_utils .
- Define the full PD-Sep deployment configuration:
  - Environment variables : common envs (including DSPARK/Spec V2, DeepEP, and HCCL related settings), plus node-specific overrides for Prefill ( HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2048 , long-sequence DeepEP parameters, etc.) and Decode ( HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1200 , SGLANG_NPU_SPLIT_SHARED_EXPERT_OVERLAP=1 , etc.).
  - Prefill node launch arguments : TP16/DP16, dsv4 attention backend, DeepEP normal mode, modelslim quantization, --disaggregation-mode prefill , Ascend transfer backend, --mem-fraction-static 0.68 , CUDA Graph disabled.
  - Decode node launch arguments : TP16/DP16, DeepEP low_latency mode, --disaggregation-mode decode , CUDA Graph decode batch sizes 1–10, DSPARK speculative decoding enabled ( --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 , with a W8A8-quantized draft model).
  - Router arguments : --policy cache_aware .
- Add test class TestNPUDeepSeekV4Flash0731W8A8PDSEPGPQAHigh , evaluating the gpqa_diamond dataset with accuracy baseline 0.874, eval batch size 128, and generation config for Think High mode ( thinking=True , reasoning_effort=high , max_tokens=125000 ).
- Register the case via register_npu_ci as a nightly test (est_time=3600, currently marked disabled="accuracy testcase" ).
2. Update nightly pipeline .github/workflows/nightly-test-npu.yml :

- Add a new deepseek_v4_flash_w8a8_1p1d_16p accuracy test entry to the multi-node test matrix (prefill_size=1, decode_size=1, router_size=1, test_type: 'accuracy' , PD separation deployment), pointing to the new test case and integrating it into the nightly NPU e2e multi-node workflow.

## Accuracy Tests

test_npu_deepseek_v4_flash_0731_w8a8_1p1d_16p_gpqa.py
![Uploading image.png…]()


## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+# Context
+
+[test_npu_performance_utils.py](file:///d:/mysglang/python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/test_npu_performance_utils.py) 已有单机、混部和 PD 分离基类，但三者的压测参数组装彼此重复，且 `accept_rate` 依赖单机风格的 `other_args`，无法直接用于多节点配置。需要新增一套可扩展基类，在不改变旧类及既有调用方行为的前提下，让后续加入新单机基类的公共能力自动复用于新混部和新 PD 分离基类。
+
+# 实施方案
+
+仅修改 `python/sglang/test/ascend/e2e/test_npu_performance_utils.py`，在现有类之后追加以下三个类，不修改旧类、全局函数或既有测试的导入：
+
+1. 新增 `TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBaseV2(TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBase)`。
+   - 作为新的单机扩展点，继承原有配置、输出、服务生命周期、`run_throughput` 和指标断言。
+   - 后续通用压测/指标能力添加到此类，避免再修改旧类。
+
+2. 新增 `TestNpuPerfMultiNodePdMixTestCaseBaseV2(TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBaseV2)`。
+   - 参考旧混部类实现 master/worker 的 `setUpClass`、节点启动和原有空 `tearDownClass`，不调用旧单机的生命周期方法，避免误启动单机服务。
+   - 启动前将 `model_config["model_path"]` 和 `model_config["other_args"]` 分别适配为 `model`、`other_args`；参数列表做拷贝，避免节点启动过程原地修改配置后影响指标读取。
+   - `run_throughput` 只保留 `check_role(master/worker)` 门控并调用 `super()`，完整 AISBench/bench-serving 组装统一复用新单机继承链；不重复添加 `@retry()`，防止嵌套重试。
+
+3. 新增 `TestNpuPerfMultiNodePdSepTestCaseBaseV2(TestNpuPerformanceTestCaseBaseV2)`。
+   - 参考旧 PD 类实现 router/prefill/decode 的启动、ConfigMap 等待、router 健康检查和进程清理，不调用旧单机生命周期。
+   - 启动前适配 `model_config["model_path"]` 为 `model`，并复制 `model_config["decode_args"]` 为 `other_args`。speculative decoding 的 draft token 参数必须来自 decode 服务，不能错误回退到 prefill/router。
+   - `run_throughput` 只保留 `check_role(router)` 门控并调用 `super()`，同样不重复 `@retry()`。
+
+该单线继承结构使 `accept_rate` 直接复用现有 `run_bench_serving` 的 `accept_length` 解析和 `assert_metrics` 的断言逻辑：单机读取 `other_args`，混部读取映射后的 `model_config["other_args"]`，PD 读取映射后的 `decode_args`。不扩展 AISBench 的接受率支持，不迁移任何旧用例。
+
+# 验证
+
+- 对目标文件执行 Python 语法编译检查。
+- 通过只读 diff 确认三个旧类及其方法未被改动，新代码仅为追加。
+- 用无 NPU 的轻量 mock/内省检查验证：新混部和 PD 的直接父类均为新单机类；二者自身覆盖生命周期；多节点 setup 不触发 `popen_launch_server`；角色门控正确；压测仅有一层重试。
+- mock `run_bench_serving` 与指标输出，验证三种部署均能按各自参数来源计算并断言 `accept_rate`，且 PD 只使用 `decode_args` 中的 `--speculative-num-draft-tokens`。

@@ -332,6 +332,76 @@ def generate_gsm8k_dataset(
             f.write("\n")
 
 
+def generate_gsm8k_shared_prefix_dataset(
+    model_path,
+    source_dataset_path,
+    batch_size,
+    input_len,
+    output_file,
+    output_format="sharegpt",
+):
+    """Generate a natural-text shared-prefix dataset from GSM8K.
+
+    bench_serving's generated-shared-prefix dataset builds prompts from
+    random token ids, which the DSPARK draft cannot predict - the measured
+    acceptance length collapses to ~1.6 vs the dev-measured 3.9 on natural
+    text. This generator instead pads one GSM8K QA pool (natural text,
+    repeated cyclically) slightly past input_len and writes batch_size
+    identical rows, so bench_serving's random-mode truncation leaves every
+    request byte-identical - the same 100%-cache shape as the dev
+    acceptance dataset (sharegpt_natural_shared_131072_100cache_480.json),
+    whose divergence points sit beyond the truncation length on purpose.
+
+    Output is a JSON array in the ShareGPT "conversations" layout that

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -e
+set -o pipefail
+
+# DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-w4a8 / Ascend 910C / 2 nodes x 16 NPUs
+# TP32 + DP8 Attention + DeepEP + DSpark
+# Target: 128k / 1k / ~90% cache / client C32; server max requests 32.
+# Run this same file on both nodes. Node rank is detected from the local IP.
+
+MODEL_PATH=/home/weights/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813-w4a8
+SGLANG_PYTHON=/home/sglang-dspark/python
+SERVED_MODEL_NAME=dsv4
+SERVER_PORT=6677
+MASTER_PORT=5567
+
+NODE_IPS=(80.5.17.39 80.5.17.40)
+HCCL_IFS=(enp194s0f0 enp194s0f0)
+NUM_NPUS_PER_NODE=16
+DP_SIZE=8
+
+# Mixed Prefill/Decode starting point. Try 8192 if TPOT exceeds 20 ms;
+# try 32768 if TTFT is too high and TPOT has headroom.
+CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE=16384
+
+# Mainly controls weight and KV allocation, not raw compute speed.
+# If startup or graph capture OOMs, try 0.78, then 0.76 on both nodes.
+MEM_FRACTION_STATIC=0.80
+
+unset https_proxy http_proxy HTTPS_PROXY HTTP_PROXY ASCEND_LAUNCH_BLOCKING
+
+[[ -d ""$MODEL_PATH"" ]] || {
+    echo ""Missing model path: $MODEL_PATH"" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+[[ -d ""$SGLANG_PYTHON/sglang"" ]] || {
+    echo ""Missing SGLang checkout: $SGLANG_PYTHON/sglang"" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+[[ ""$CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE"" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] &&
+    (( CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE > 0 )) || {
+    echo ""Invalid CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE: $CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE"" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+NODE_RANK=
+SERVER_HOST=
+read -r -a LOCAL_IPS <<< ""$(hostname -I)""
+
+for i in ""${!NODE_IPS[@]}""; do
+    for ip in ""${LOCAL_IPS[@]}""; do
+        if [[ ""$ip"" == ""${NODE_IPS[$i]}"" ]]; then
+            NODE_RANK=$i
+            SERVER_HOST=$ip
+            export HCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=""${HCCL_IFS[$i]}""
+            export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=""${HCCL_IFS[$i]}""
+            break 2
+        fi
+    done
+done
+
+[[ -n ""$NODE_RANK"" ]] || {
+    echo ""Cannot detect node rank; local IPs: ${LOCAL_IPS[*]}"" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+
+NNODES=${#NODE_IPS[@]}
+TP_SIZE=$((NNODES * NUM_NPUS_PER_NODE))
+DIST_INIT_ADDR=""${NODE_IPS[0]}:${MASTER_PORT}""
+
+# Ascend environment
+source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/opp/vendors/customize/bin/set_env.bash
+source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/opp/vendors/custom_transformer/bin/set_env.bash
+source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/set_env.sh
+source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
+
+export PYTHONPATH=""${SGLANG_PYTHON}${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}""
+
+# Read the native DSpark block size from the checkpoint.
+# For the confirmed checkpoint, dspark_block_size=5, so verify window=6.
+# Override DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE on both nodes only for a measured comparison.
+CHECKPOINT_DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE=""$(python3 - ""$MODEL_PATH/config.json"" <<'PY'
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+cfg = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
+value = cfg.get(""dspark_block_size"")
+if value is None:
+    value = (cfg.get(""dflash_config"") or {}).get(""block_size"")
+if value is None:
+    value = cfg.get(""block_size"")
+if value is None:
+    print(
+        ""DSpark block size missing in config.json; using upstream 0813 default 5"",
+        file=sys.stderr,
+    )
+    value = 5
+if int(value) < 1:
+    raise SystemExit(f""Invalid checkpoint DSpark block size: {value}"")
+print(int(value))
+PY
+)""
+
+DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE=${DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE:-$CHECKPOINT_DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE}
+[[ ""$DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE"" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE > 0 )) || {
+    echo ""Invalid DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE: $DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE"" >&2
+    exit 1
+}
+DSPARK_VERIFY_TOKENS=$((DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE + 1))
+
+if (( DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE > CHECKPOINT_DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE )); then
+    echo ""Warning: DSpark override $DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE exceeds checkpoint-native $CHECKPOINT_DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE"" >&2
+fi
+
+# CPU and communication environment
+echo performance |
+    tee /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu*/cpufreq/scaling_governor >/dev/null || true
+sysctl -w vm.swappiness=0 >/dev/null || true
+sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0 >/dev/null || true
+
+export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=300
+export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=300
+export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV
+export ACL_DEVICE_SYNC_TIMEOUT=60
+export DEEPEP_HCCL_BUFFSIZE=2000
+
+# NPU memory and MoE streams
+export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
+export STREAMS_PER_DEVICE=32
+export SGLANG_SET_CPU_AFFINITY=1
+export SGLANG_NPU_USE_MULTI_STREAM=1
+
+# Checkpoint Experts are ModelSlim W4A8_DYNAMIC, not MXFP4.
+export SGLANG_DSV4_FP4_EXPERTS=False
+
+# Preserve the Ascend/ModelSlim implementation choices from the running setup.
+export SGLANG_OPT_USE_OVERLAP_STORE_CACHE=False
+export FORCE_DRAFT_MODEL_NON_QUANT=1
+export SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_WQA_WKV=0
+export SGLANG_OPT_BF16_FP32_GEMM_ALGO=torch
+export SGLANG_OPT_USE_FUSED_HASH_TOPK=False
+export SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_PRE=False
+export SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_HC_PRENORM=False
+export SGLANG_OPT_USE_TILELANG_MHC_POST=False
+export SGLANG_OPT_FP8_WO_A_GEMM=False
+
+# DeepEP
+export SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK=128
+export DEEPEP_HYBRID_DEPLOYMENT=1
+export DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT=1
+
+# DSpark on Ascend
+export SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1
+export SGLANG_ENABLE_OVERLAP_PLAN_STREAM=1
+export SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static
+
+# Distinct from SGLANG_NPU_USE_MULTI_STREAM above.
+export SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_KERNEL=0
+export SGLANG_DSPARK_FAST_SAMPLING=0
+export SGLANG_DSPARK_ENABLE_MULTI_STREAM=0
+
+export SGLANG_DSPARK_QUANT_AUDIT=1
+export SGLANG_DSPARK_QUANT_AUDIT_STRICT=0
+export TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY=error
+
+echo ""==============================================""
+echo ""DeepSeek-V4-Pro PR40399 / Ascend 910C""
+echo ""node-rank: $NODE_RANK / $NNODES; local IP: $SERVER_HOST""
+echo ""dist-init: $DIST_INIT_ADDR; TP: $TP_SIZE; DP: $DP_SIZE""
+echo ""SGLang: $(python3 -c 'import sglang; print(sglang.__file__)')""
+echo ""static mem: $MEM_FRACTION_STATIC; prefill chunk: $CHUNKED_PREFILL_SIZE""
+echo ""DSpark: block $DSPARK_BLOCK_SIZE; verify $DSPARK_VERIFY_TOKENS""
+echo ""==============================================""
+
+# Avoid killing unrelated Python processes on a shared node.
+if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
+    ss -H -ltn ""( sport = :$SERVER_PORT )"" | grep -q .; then
